templates.name: 星灵铠甲觉醒

templates.description_en: Single image of the Img1 lead: emotional close-up -> a glowing medium in the palm or an emblem on the body triggers the transformation -> armour plates condense from points of light and lock onto the body one by one -> freeze on drawing the sword. Can follow a constellation or elemental effects theme.

templates.name: 文字指令换人/换龄
templates.description: 纯文生：画面中一个人随时间轴平滑变为婴儿→童年→老年版本，同一人不同年龄段，面部骨相连贯变化。
templates.description_en: Pure text-to-video: a person in frame smoothly becomes their infant, childhood and elderly versions along the timeline, the same person at different ages with facial bone structure changing continuously.
templates.generation_mode: Text to Video (文生视频)【图3可选场景】
templates.prompt:
[DEFAULT CONFIGURATION / 默认配置声明]: This is a text-to-video prompt with NO reference image. The default subject is a young East Asian woman in her early twenties, long straight black hair, balanced slim build, natural everyday outfit, neutral plain studio background. The entire age-change sequence must keep her the SAME recognizable person — face, bone structure and identity flow continuously through every age stage; no different person is introduced. 中文复述：本提示词无参考图，默认主角为一位二十出头的东亚年轻女性，黑长直长发、匀称身材、日常便服、中性纯色棚拍背景；全片为同一人不同年龄段的连贯变化，面部骨相连贯，严禁中途换人。

integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] [0-10s] Cinematic, soft even studio light, plain neutral backdrop. Fixed medium shot of the subject standing center frame. 【ACTION】The video runs one continuous time-lapse of the SAME person's aging in a single frame: starting as the young adult woman, her features smoothly de-age — face rounding, eyes large, shrinking down into a chubby baby, then a toddler, then a school-age child; the flow reverses and she ages forward through youth, middle age, until the final moments show a graceful elderly version of the same face, wrinkles and silver hair arriving gradually; at every transition the underlying bone structure and identity stay recognizably hers.【/ACTION】 One single recognizable identity across all age stages; coherent facial continuity, seamless morph, no distortion, no extra limbs.

overall_soundscape: Quiet room tone, faint soft air whoosh marking each age-stage transition, gentle breath.

non_diegetic_music: Tender ambient piano solo, slow reflective tempo, swelling softly as the years pass, ending warm and resolved.
